pipeline_result.response: Haruki Murakami said that writing "Dance Dance Dance" had been a healing act after his unexpected fame following the publication of "Norwegian Wood" and that, because of this, he had enjoyed writing "Dance" more than any other. The novel was published in 1987.
retrieved_context: Dance Dance Dance (novel): Dance Dance Dance (ダンス・ダンス・ダンス , Dansu Dansu Dansu ) is the sixth novel by Japanese writer Haruki Murakami.  First published in 1988, it was translated into English by Alfred Birnbaum in 1994.  The book is a sequel to Murakami's novel "A Wild Sheep Chase".  In 2001, Murakami said that writing "Dance Dance Dance" had been a healing act after his unexpected fame following the publication of "Norwegian Wood" and that, because of this, he had enjoyed writing "Dance" more than any other.
Norwegian Wood (novel): Norwegian Wood (ノルウェイの森 , Noruwei no Mori ) is a 1987 novel by Japanese author Haruki Murakami.

Pinball, 1973: Pinball, 1973 (1973年のピンボール , Sen-Kyūhyaku-Nanajū-San-Nen no Pinbōru ) is a novel published in 1980 by Japanese author Haruki Murakami.  The second book in the "Trilogy of the Rat" series, it is preceded by "Hear the Wind Sing" (1979) and followed by "A Wild Sheep Chase" (1982), and is the second novel written by Murakami.
